kept.name: TestErrFields_EmitsEnvelopeWithFields
kept.reason: pins the supplied fields kept and the reserved keys overridden, which TestErr_EmitsErrorEnvelope does not assert

kept.name: TestErrFields_NilFieldsMatchesErr
kept.reason: pins byte-identical output of ErrFields(nil) and Err, which TestErr_EmitsErrorEnvelope and TestErrFields_EmitsEnvelopeWithFields do not compare

kept.name: TestErr_EmitsErrorEnvelope
kept.reason: pins ok=false, exit code 1 and the trimmed error field, which TestErrFields_NilFieldsMatchesErr only compares byte-for-byte
